newsitem.title: USA: U.S. judge postpones rulings in FDA/tobacco case.
newsitem.headline: U.S. judge postpones rulings in FDA/tobacco case.

text.p: The federal judge weighing tobacco companies' court challenge to federal curbs on selling cigarettes will not rule before next Wednesday, his office said Friday.

U.S. District Court Judge William Osteen heard arguments on February 10 that the Food and Drug Administration had overstepped its authority with the new regulations and that advertising curbs included in the regulations violated U.S. guarantees of free speech.
According to a telephone tape recording at Osteen's office, the judge will not rule until next Wednesday or later. A previous recorded message said a ruling could come Monday.
